name: Invisibility Cloak (3/Day)
description: The creature and one creature riding it (chosen by the creature) magically turn invisible. This effect lasts until the creature or a creature riding it attacks or casts a spell, or until the creature’s concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). Any equipment worn or carried by the invisible creatures is also invisible for the duration of the Invisibility Cloak.
